title: Taiwan Compact Runtime Identity Index Manifest
description: Schema for the manifest accompanying the compact runtime identity index

manifest_schema_version.description: Version of the compact manifest schema

compact_index_schema_version.description: Version of the compact index schema that this manifest validates

index_id.description: Unique identifier for this compact index (matches the index_id in the compact index)

source_bundle_id.description: ID of the source Security Master bundle

source_snapshot_id.description: Identifier of the source snapshot within the bundle

source_snapshot_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the source snapshot (dryrun_snapshot.json)

source_skill_contract_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the skill contract used to generate the source bundle

compact_index_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the compact index file

compact_index_schema_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the compact index schema file

compact_manifest_schema_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the compact manifest schema file

compact_index_path.description: Relative path to the compact index file from repository root

record_count.description: Number of records in the compact index (must match compact index record_count)

coverage.description: Coverage statistics derived from the source bundle

knowledge_universe_count.description: Total number of identities in the source bundle

runtime_eligible_count.description: Number of identities eligible for runtime use

quarantined_count.description: Number of identities in quarantined status

generated_at_utc.description: Timestamp when the compact manifest was generated (ISO 8601 UTC)

producer_version.description: Version of the software that produced this manifest

artifact_persisted_in_git.description: Whether the compact index artifact is persisted in Git (should be false for this implementation)
